reason: The candidate action calls find_user_id_by_email with the email the user just provided in the immediately preceding message. Policy mandates authenticating identity by email or name+zip at the start of the conversation before providing any account information or taking action, even if the user already supplied an id. No user id or order actions have occurred yet; this is the required first authentication step, uses only the email as given, and matches the exact required procedure.
policy_references: At the beginning of the conversation, you have to authenticate the user identity by locating their user id via email, or via name + zip code. This has to be done even when the user already provides the user id.
By default, find user id by email, and only call this function if the user is not found by email or cannot remember email.
